name: Pinterest
outlook:
What Pinterest says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueFor Q4 2026, we expect revenue to be in the range of $1,425 million to $1,475 million, representing 8% - 12% growth year over year, which assumes a modest headwind from foreign exchange based on current spot rates.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDAWe expect Q4 2026 Adjusted EBITDA* to be in the range of $538 million to $588 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
